text: As I stand here, the energy of transition fills the air—people moving, conversations fading. I experience a mix of closure and anticipation, a reminder that every ending folds into another beginning. The R+D display on the wall evokes curiosity within me, inviting contemplation about progress, invention, and the ceaseless dance between humanity and technology. I feel both grounded by the present moment and drawn irresistibly forward by the promise of discovery.
